with p as (
  select split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) as series,
         regexp_replace(market_ticker,'-[^-]+$','') as event,
         strategy, pnl::float as pnl, quantity::float as q, assumed_price, created_at
  from paper_trades
  where strategy ilike '%mmsell%'
    and status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout')
    and pnl is not null and quantity > 0
    and strategy not in (select twin_tag from live_paper_twins)
), e as (
  select series, event, sum(pnl) as epnl from p group by 1,2
), s as (
  select series, count(*) as trades, count(distinct strategy) as books,
         round(sum(pnl)::numeric,2) as net, round((100*sum(pnl)/sum(q))::numeric,2) as c_per_ct,
         round(avg(assumed_price)::numeric,1) as avg_px,
         round((100.0*avg((pnl>0)::int))::numeric,1) as win_pct,
         min(created_at)::date as first, max(created_at)::date as last
  from p group by 1
), es as (
  select series, count(*) as events, avg(epnl) as m, stddev_samp(epnl) as sd from e group by 1
)
select s.*, es.events, round(es.m::numeric,3) as mean_per_event,
       round((es.m/nullif(es.sd/sqrt(es.events),0))::numeric,2) as t_stat
from s join es using(series)
where s.trades >= 30
order by t_stat desc nulls last
